title: FIA Convening Government and Industry on UK Market Framework for Fusion - Fusion Industry Association
html:
The Fusion Industry Association is leading a new, industry-led process to help shape the market and finance framework for commercial fusion in the UK. Launching on 14 December (details below), FIA will convene government, investors, project financiers, insurers, fusion developers, utilities, constructors, operators, offtakers and other stakeholders for discussions.

The sixth-month process will explore the measures needed to establish the UK as an attractive market for commercial fusion investment, drawing on expertise to identify the key parameters of a viable market framework.

In its 2026 Fusion Strategy released in March, the UK Government committed to developing a market framework to support the delivery and operation of commercial fusion power plants. FIA first called for such a framework in December 2024 and will now work with government and industry to help shape the conditions needed to bring it forward.

As fusion companies advance towards deployment in the 2030s, attention is increasingly shifting to the conditions needed to finance, build, and operate the first generation of commercial fusion power plants. Establishing the proper framework supports the UK’s ambition to translate its leadership in fusion research and development into commercial deployment.

The UK is particularly well positioned to lead this next phase. It has built a world-leading fusion research base and workforce, and was the first country to establish its risk-appropriate regulatory framework for fusion. The Government further strengthened that position by releasing a paper setting out the UK’s regulatory landscape for fusion. It is also taking steps to streamline the planning process for fusion power plants through its recently released draft National Policy Statement on Fusion Energy Generation (NPS-EN8), which was the subject of a parliamentary evidence session in September as part of Parliament’s inquiry into the statement. And, of any country, the UK has committed the highest share of its GDP to fusion funding – showing a sustained commitment to leading globally in deployment.

Now, with direct input from industry, the UK has an opportunity to become the first country to develop a dedicated market and finance framework for fusion – setting out the conditions needed to translate its global leadership into a lasting commercial fusion market.

Date: 14 December, 2026
Time: 14:00-17:00 GMT
Format: Virtual webinar
Register: Online

The webinar will establish the foundation for these discussions, examining the UK Government’s perspective, the existing financing landscape, and the considerations of financial institutions in supporting commercial fusion projects.

Agenda:

  • UK government perspective on the market framework for fusion
  • Overview of the financing landscape
  • Panel discussion with financiers
  • Q&A session
summary: The Fusion Industry Association is leading a new industry-led process to help shape the market framework for commercial fusion in the UK.
